relationships.subject: VEGF
relationships.evidence_quote: Several in vitro studies have demonstrated that VEGF signaling directly impacts the increase in the levels of pro-catabolic mediators in cartilage cells, with exogenous VEGF stimulating the production of proinflammatory cytokines [33].

key_findings: COL11A1 rs4907986/rs1241164, VEGF rs833058 and GDF5 rs143383 polymorphisms did not differ significantly between knee OA patients and controls in a Turkish cohort.
GDF5 rs143383 variant genotype was more frequent than wild type in both groups, suggested as a possible early marker.
